## Invariant

What rule does this change establish or preserve?

## User-visible result

What can a user do or understand after this change?

## Verification

List focused tests, repository gates, and end-to-end evidence.

## Qualification boundary

What adjacent claim remains untested or outside this pull request?

## Checklist

- [ ] The change has one clear owner and no unrelated edits.
- [ ] Success, rejection, and boundary cases are tested.
- [ ] Documentation has one home for each changed contract.
- [ ] Generated research state and credentials are absent from the diff.
